name: ambientCG
summary: CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs, decals and 3D models from ambientCG: search assets with their metadata and download links, and list categories and collections.

api_key.description: Optional API token shown at ambientCG.com/activate to Patreon supporters; it unlocks their tier's benefits (early access, exclusive files).

notes: Keyless for the public CC0 library; a token only adds Patreon benefits.
Read-only: every v3 call is a GET.
Run by one person: the operator warns it may be less reliable than an enterprise API, so cache results.

endpoints.name: Search assets
endpoints.summary: Assets matching keywords, type, technique, id or release date, with the metadata and download links chosen by include.

q.description: Keywords separated by commas or spaces, combined with AND.

type.description: Comma-separated (OR) data types: material, hdri, substance, decal, atlas, 3d-model, plain-image, brush, terrain, hdri-element. An invalid value returns nothing.

technique.description: Comma-separated (OR) creation techniques, e.g. surface-photogrammetry, surface-fully-procedural, model-photogrammetry, hdri-bracketed-panorama.

sort.description: Order; popular when unset or unrecognized.

id.description: Comma-separated asset ids, e.g. PavingStones036; unknown ids are ignored.

date.description: Only assets released on this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Results to return, 1 to 500; 100 by default.

offset.description: Results to skip; only applies when limit is set.

include.description: Comma-separated fields to return: type, releaseDate, shortDescription, longDescription, title, url, tags, colors, dimensions, downloadStatistics, maps, technique, downloads, relations, collections, previews, thumbnails.

notes: Download URLs are only in the response when include contains downloads.
